title: main.rs: CLI args, session init, update run() signature
description:
What: Add --url/--cert CLI args, bootstrap JMAP session and SSE in main.rs, update event::run() signature.

Algorithm:
1. In main.rs: add #[derive(Parser)] struct Args { #[arg(long)] url: String, #[arg(long)] cert: std::path::PathBuf } using clap.
2. Validate: args.url must start with "https://"; if not, eprintln! and return Err.
3. Call client::read_cert_der(&args.cert)? — propagate error if file not found.
4. Call client::build_client(&cert_der)? — propagate if cert invalid DER.
5. Set state.connection_status = ConnectionStatus::Connecting.
6. Call client::fetch_session(&http_client, &args.url).await?; on error, set state.connection_status = ConnectionStatus::Error(...) and return.
7. Store session.api_url and session.event_source_url.
8. Call client::spawn_sse(http_client.clone(), session.event_source_url.clone()) -> (sse_rx, _sse_handle). Store _sse_handle to keep it alive (let _sse_handle = ...).
9. Update event::run() signature: pub async fn run(terminal, state, http_client: reqwest::Client, api_url: String, sse_rx: mpsc::Receiver<kith_core::StateChange>) -> Result<()>.
   - Remove session parameter; pass only api_url (String) and http_client since account_id is always "a-self".
10. Update the call site in main.rs to pass the new params.

Defensive programming rules:
- Never log cert bytes, URL query params, or any secret material.
- If fetch_session fails, clean up terminal before returning.
- No unwrap() in main.rs; all fallible calls use ?.
- HTTPS-only: reject http:// URLs explicitly.

Agent team: R reads main.rs, event.rs, client.rs; I implements; T writes unit tests for arg parsing and URL validation; V runs cargo test -p kith-tui + cargo clippy.

Tests:
- Unit: Args::parse_from(["kith-tui", "--url", "https://x", "--cert", "/tmp/x"]) parses correctly (oracle: field values).
- Unit: URL starting with http:// triggers error (oracle: error returned).
- Integration (wiremock): mock /.well-known/jmap returns valid session JSON; fetch_session returns ClientSession with correct api_url.
